title: Foundations of Survey Design for Official Statistics
description: Introduces survey objectives, frames, questionnaires, sample planning, field protocols, and quality checks for official statistical surveys.

title: Sampling Methods and Estimation
description: Covers probability sampling, stratification, cluster sampling, sampling errors, weights, and estimation workflows.

title: National Accounts Concepts and Compilation
description: Explains GDP, sector accounts, source data, compilation practices, revisions, and quality documentation for national accounts.

title: Consumer Price Index and Price Statistics
description: Builds capability in price collection, item baskets, index calculation, validation, and dissemination of price statistics.

title: Labour Force Statistics and Employment Indicators
description: Introduces labour-force concepts, employment indicators, questionnaire design, tabulation, and interpretation for policy use.

title: Agricultural Statistics for Planning and Monitoring
description: Covers crop statistics, area and yield estimation, administrative data, remote-sensing linkages, and validation.

title: Industrial Statistics and Business Registers
description: Focuses on industrial classifications, business registers, frame maintenance, survey operations, and tabulation.

title: SDG Indicator Monitoring and Metadata
description: Teaches SDG indicator definitions, metadata templates, disaggregation, data sources, and publication readiness.

title: Data Quality Frameworks in Official Statistics
description: Explains relevance, accuracy, timeliness, coherence, comparability, accessibility, and audit-ready quality reporting.

title: Python for Data Analysis in Government
description: Hands-on Python course covering data cleaning, pandas workflows, charts, notebooks, and reproducible analysis.

title: R for Statistical Reporting
description: Uses R for statistical summaries, tidy data, visualization, and publication-ready official statistics tables.

title: SQL for Administrative Data Systems
description: Introduces database querying, joins, validation checks, aggregations, and safe extraction from administrative datasets.

title: GIS Mapping for Statistical Dissemination
description: Applies GIS to district indicators, thematic maps, spatial joins, and visual communication of statistical outputs.

title: Dashboards and Data Visualization for Policy
description: Covers chart selection, dashboard design, accessibility, storytelling, and decision-focused visualization.

title: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning for Public Officials
description: Introduces AI concepts, supervised learning, model evaluation, responsible use, and public-sector examples.

title: Cloud Computing Essentials for Government Applications
description: Explains cloud service models, hosting patterns, government cloud options, security, availability, and cost awareness.

title: API Fundamentals and Data Exchange
description: Builds understanding of REST APIs, authentication, payloads, data exchange standards, and privacy-aware integration.

title: Stata for Survey Data Processing
description: Practical Stata workflows for survey cleaning, weighting, tabulation, reproducible scripts, and validation outputs.

title: SPSS and SAS for Statistical Production
description: Covers data import, transformations, descriptive statistics, quality checks, and repeatable production workflows.

title: Data Privacy and Personal Data Protection
description: Explains privacy principles, lawful processing, minimization, consent awareness, access control, and responsible data sharing.

title: Cybersecurity Hygiene for Government Officials
description: Covers passwords, phishing, secure devices, digital certificates, incident reporting, and secure handling of official data.

title: Digital Signatures and e-Office Workflows
description: Introduces digital signature certificates, secure approvals, e-office processes, and audit trails in government workflows.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure for Service Delivery
description: Explains DPI architecture, registries, secure data exchange, identity layers, and citizen-service interoperability.

title: Leadership for Data-Driven Governance
description: Develops leadership habits for evidence-based decisions, stakeholder alignment, team accountability, and public value.

title: Project Management for Statistical Operations
description: Covers work planning, milestones, risks, field coordination, quality gates, reporting, and stakeholder communication.

title: Ethics in Official Statistics
description: Explores impartiality, confidentiality, transparency, data integrity, misuse prevention, and trust in official statistics.

title: Communication of Statistical Findings
description: Builds skills for briefing notes, presentations, indicator interpretation, uncertainty communication, and executive summaries.

title: Change Management for Digital Transformation
description: Helps officials plan adoption, manage resistance, communicate benefits, and sustain digital transformation projects.

title: Responsible AI for Official Statistics
description: Covers model governance, bias, explainability, privacy, auditability, and responsible use of AI in statistical systems.

title: Advanced Open Data Publishing and APIs
description: Focuses on machine-readable datasets, API-enabled dissemination, metadata quality, licensing, and reusable data products.
